newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota says 'reasonable' dollar rate 110-120 yen.
newsitem.headline: Toyota says 'reasonable' dollar rate 110-120 yen.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp president Hiroshi Okuda said on Tuesday a "reasonable" exchange rate for the dollar was 110 to 120 yen.

Asked if Japan's rising trade surplus with the United States would lead to new trade friction between them, he said Japanese carmakers' U.S.-bound exports this year would be flat or only slightly higher.
He did not see the issue of car trade causing a renewal of trade friction between the two countries.
A Toyota official said the company was positively considering introducing a stock option scheme for its employees.
Industry sources said the company would reach a decision on Wednesday on whether to introduce such a scheme.
Toyota launched a new compact multipurpose vehicle, the Raum, in Japan on Tuesday with a monthly sales target of 4,000 units.
Okuda said he expected sales to reach 8,000 units a month initially.
Another official said Toyota had no plans to export the new model.
